news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 10%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2027 has deteriorated. 2027 revenue forecast decreased from ₹6.76b to ₹6.20b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹16.00 per share to ₹14.35 per share. Net income forecast to grow 25% next year vs 14% growth forecast for Retail Distributors industry in India. Consensus price target of ₹566 unchanged from last update. Share price was steady at ₹421 over the past week.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹11.63 (up from ₹8.95 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹4.96b (up 33% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹650.2m (up 33% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 13% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 11%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 2.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Retail Distributors industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 9% per year and the company’s share price has also increased by 9% per year.
